title: A finished turn records how it ended and a swept turn closes before the next opens, a partial EmDash replace is reported, a target refusal frees the lease, a picture on a Model Subscription is named, and the outage shortcut belongs to one speaker on one site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (after `pnpm dsh:build`, which review-turn-close needs) run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/review-turn-close.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/review-emdash-changed-report.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/review-account-subscriptions.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/review-subscription-images.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/review-seat-plan-images.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'a turn that completed normally tells tracy-web it completed' and 'a turn cut at the output-token ceiling tells tracy-web so' pass: the /moment body carries endReason completed / max-tokens on dsh's real agent loop.
'a swept turn's moment is answered before the next turn's model runs' passes.
'a PARTIAL EmDash replace that wrote 4 places is reported as a write' passes.
The two outage-shortcut tests and 'a subscription route declares which inputs it reads' pass.
Both 'a dsh picture sent to … is either carried or named' tests pass.
fence: Each test drives the mechanism with the input that broke it: dsh's real agent loop with a scripted model and a held /moment; the real EmDash replace job driven to PARTIAL; a pin door that refuses then goes down; a dsh image reference on the wire. No model, no network, no Postgres. The lease release on APPLY_TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED needs Postgres and is held by apps/tracy-web/test/review-apply-write-door.test.mjs.

tests: a turn that completed normally tells tracy-web it completed
a turn cut at the output-token ceiling tells tracy-web so
a swept turn's moment is answered before the next turn's model runs
a PARTIAL EmDash replace that wrote 4 places is reported as a write
a seat refused by tracy-web is not let through on the default when tracy-web then goes down
the outage shortcut belongs to the speaker tracy-web answered
a subscription route declares which inputs it reads
a dsh picture sent to Claude is either carried or named, never dropped
a dsh picture sent to Codex is either carried or named, never dropped
